name: [6 PLAYERS!] Monopoly
desc:
UPDATE NOTES (10/16/2026):
The Halloween update is here!

New map: Haunted Mansion!
Earn Candy by completing games and collecting rent!
Play the new Jack's Curse 🎃 game mode, where Jack occasionally throws scrolls on the board with tempting offers (also gives 1.5x Candy).  Available in tables, custom lobbies, and global queue!
Use your Candy to unlock new, limited-time cosmetics from the Halloween Box, including a new Mythic piece: Jack!

...and more! View all the patch notes in the Lobby by tapping 'Notes' on the top-left.

_______________________________

1:1 recreation of Monopoly!

Doesn't follow the traditional rulebook 100%

_______________________________


Please leave a rating, then the feedback button will pop up. I'd appreciate your thoughts/bug reports!
(you can also leave feedback in the Lobby now)
